newFire.lat:
℣. Dóminus vobíscum.
℟. Et cum spíritu tuo.
Orémus.
Deus, qui per Fílium tuum, angulárem scílicet lápidem, claritátis tuæ ignem fidélibus contulísti: prodúctum e sílice, nostris profutúrum úsibus, novum hunc ignem sanctí ✠ fica: et concéde nobis, ita per hæc festa paschália cœléstibus desidériis inflammári; ut ad perpétuæ claritátis, puris méntibus, valeámus festa pertíngere. Per eúndem Christum Dóminum nostrum.
℟. Amen.
newFire.en:
℣. The Lord be with you.
℟. And with thy spirit.
Let us pray.
O God, Who through Thy Son, the cornerstone, hast bestowed upon the faithful the fire of Thy brightness: sanctify ✠ this new fire, struck from the flint for our use; and grant that during these Paschal festivities we may be so inflamed with heavenly desires that, with purified minds, we may attain the feast of everlasting light. Through the same Christ our Lord.
℟. Amen.
newFire.fr: La Vigile pascale commence par la bénédiction du feu nouveau. Les cloches et l’orgue restent silencieux ; la crécelle les remplace jusqu’au Gloria de la Messe.

℣. Dóminus vobíscum.
℟. Et cum spíritu tuo.
Orémus.
Véniat, quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus, super hoc incénsum céreum larga tuæ bene ✠ dictiónis infúsio: et hunc noctúrnum splendórem invisíbilis regenerátor, inténde; ut non solum sacrifícium, quod hac nocte litátum est, arcána lúminis tui admixtióne refúlgeat; sed in quocúmque loco ex huius sanctificatiónis mystério aliquid fúerit deportátum, expúlsa diabólicæ fraudis nequítia, virtus tuæ maiestátis assístat. Per Christum Dóminum nostrum.
℟. Amen.
paschalCandle.en:
Christ yesterday and today,
the Beginning and the End,
Alpha and Omega;
His are the times
and the ages;
to Him be glory and dominion
through all the ages of eternity. Amen.

Through His holy
and glorious wounds,
may Christ the Lord
guard
and preserve us. Amen.

May the light of Christ, gloriously risen,
dispel the darkness of heart and mind.

℣. The Lord be with you.
℟. And with thy spirit.
Let us pray.
May the abundant outpouring of Thy ✠ blessing, we beseech Thee, almighty God, descend upon this burning candle; and do Thou, invisible Regenerator, enlighten this night, so that not only the sacrifice offered this night may shine with the hidden mingling of Thy light, but wherever anything from this sacred mystery is carried, the malice of diabolical deceit may be driven out and the power of Thy majesty may be present. Through Christ our Lord.
℟. Amen.
paschalCandle.fr: Le cierge pascal est préparé, marqué, garni des grains d’encens, allumé au feu nouveau et béni avant la procession dans l’église.

exsultet.lat:
Exsúltet iam Angélica turba cælórum: exsúltent divína mystéria: et pro tanti Regis victória tuba ínsonet salutáris. Gáudeat et tellus tantis irradiáta fulgóribus: et ætérni Regis splendóre illustráta, totíus orbis se séntiat amisísse calíginem. Lætétur et mater Ecclésia, tanti lúminis adornáta fulgóribus: et magnis populórum vócibus hæc aula resúltet. Quaprópter astántes vos, fratres caríssimi, ad tam miram huius sancti lúminis claritátem, una mecum, quæso, Dei omnipoténtis misericórdiam invocáte. Ut, qui me non meis méritis intra Levitárum númerum dignatus est aggregáre: lúminis sui claritátem infúndens, Cérei huius laudem implére perfíciat. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium suum: qui cum eo vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus: per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
℟. Amen.

℣. Dóminus vobíscum.
℟. Et cum spíritu tuo.
℣. Sursum corda.
℟. Habémus ad Dóminum.
℣. Grátias agámus Dómino Deo nostro.
℟. Dignum et iustum est.

Vere dignum et iustum est, invísibilem Deum Patrem omnipoténtem Filiúmque eius unigénitum, Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, toto cordis ac mentis afféctu et vocis ministério personáre. Qui pro nobis ætérno Patri Adæ débitum solvit: et véteris piáculi cautiónem pio cruóre detérsit. Hæc sunt enim festa paschália, in quibus verus ille Agnus occíditur, cuius sánguine postes fidélium consecrántur.

Hæc nox est, in qua primum patres nostros, fílios Israël edúctos de Ægýpto, Mare Rubrum sicco vestígio transire fecísti. Hæc ígitur nox est, quæ peccatórum ténebras colúmnæ illuminatióne purgávit. Hæc nox est, quæ hódie per univérsum mundum in Christo credéntes, a vítiis sǽculi et calígine peccatórum segregátos, reddit grátiæ, sóciat sanctitáti. Hæc nox est, in qua, destrúctis vínculis mortis, Christus ab ínferis victor ascéndit. Nihil enim nobis nasci prófuit, nisi rédimi profuísset.

O mira circa nos tuæ pietátis dignátio! O inæstimábilis diléctio caritátis: ut servum redímeres, Fílium tradidísti! O certe necessárium Adæ peccátum, quod Christi morte delétum est! O felix culpa, quæ talem ac tantum méruit habére Redemptórem! O vere beáta nox, quæ sola méruit scire tempus et horam, in qua Christus ab ínferis resurréxit! Hæc nox est, de qua scriptum est: Et nox sicut dies illuminábitur: et nox illuminátio mea in delíciis meis.

Huius ígitur sanctificátio noctis fugat scélera, culpas lavat: et reddit innocéntiam lapsis et mæstis lætítiam. Fugat ódia, concórdiam parat et curvat impéria.

In huius ígitur noctis grátia, súscipe, sancte Pater, incénsi huius sacrifícium vespertínum: quod tibi in hac Cérei oblatióne solémni, per ministrórum manus de opéribus apum, sacrosáncta reddit Ecclésia. Sed iam colúmnæ huius præcónia nóvimus, quam in honórem Dei rútilans ignis accéndit. Qui licet sit divísus in partes, mutuáti tamen lúminis detriménta non novit. Alitur enim liquántibus ceris, quas in substántiam pretiósæ huius lámpadis apis mater edúxit.

O vere beáta nox, quæ exspoliávit Ægýptios, ditávit Hebrǽos! Nox, in qua terrénis cæléstia, humánis divína iungúntur.

Orámus ergo te, Dómine: ut Céreus iste in honórem tui nóminis consecrátus, ad noctis huius calíginem destruéndam, indefíciens persevéret. Et in odórem suavitátis accéptus, supérnis lumináribus misceátur. Flammas eius lúcifer matutínus invéniat. Ille, inquam, lúcifer, qui nescit occásum. Ille, qui regréssus ab ínferis, humáno géneri serénus illúxit.

Precámur ergo te, Dómine: ut nos fámulos tuos, omnémque clerum, et devotíssimum pópulum: una cum beatíssimo Papa nostro N., et Antístite nostro N., quiéte témporum concéssa, in his paschálibus gáudiis, assídua protectióne régere, gubernáre et conserváre dignéris. Réspice étiam ad eos, qui nos in potestáte regunt, et, ineffábili pietátis et misericórdiæ tuæ múnere, dírige cogitatiónes eórum ad iustítiam et pacem, ut de terréna operositáte ad cæléstem pátriam pervéniant cum omni pópulo tuo.

Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus: per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
℟. Amen.
exsultet.en:
Let the angelic host of heaven now rejoice; let the divine mysteries exult; and let the trumpet of salvation proclaim the victory of so great a King. Let the earth also rejoice, radiant with such splendour, and, enlightened by the brightness of the eternal King, know that the darkness of the whole world has been dispelled. Let Mother Church rejoice, adorned with the brightness of so great a light, and let this sacred place resound with the mighty voices of the people.

Therefore, dearly beloved brethren, standing in the wondrous brightness of this holy light, I ask you to invoke with me the mercy of almighty God: that He who, without merit of mine, has deigned to number me among His ministers may pour into me the splendour of His light and enable me to complete the praise of this candle. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, His Son, Who with Him lives and reigns in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, for ever and ever.
℟. Amen.

℣. The Lord be with you.
℟. And with thy spirit.
℣. Lift up your hearts.
℟. We have lifted them up to the Lord.
℣. Let us give thanks to the Lord our God.
℟. It is meet and just.

It is truly meet and just to proclaim, with the whole affection of heart and mind and with the service of our voice, the invisible God, the almighty Father, and His only-begotten Son, our Lord Jesus Christ. He paid on our behalf to the eternal Father the debt of Adam, and by the merciful shedding of His Blood cancelled the bond of the ancient sin. For these are the Paschal feasts in which that true Lamb is slain, by Whose Blood the doorposts of the faithful are consecrated.

This is the night in which Thou didst first lead our fathers, the children of Israel, out of Egypt and make them pass dry-shod through the Red Sea. This is the night which dispelled the darkness of sin by the light of the pillar. This is the night which today, throughout the whole world, restores to grace and joins to holiness those who believe in Christ, separated from the vices of the world and the darkness of sin. This is the night in which Christ, breaking the bonds of death, rose victorious from the grave. For our birth would have profited us nothing had we not been redeemed.

O wonderful condescension of Thy mercy toward us! O immeasurable love of charity: to redeem a servant, Thou gavest up Thy Son! O truly necessary sin of Adam, destroyed by the death of Christ! O happy fault, which merited to have such and so great a Redeemer! O truly blessed night, which alone deserved to know the time and hour when Christ rose from the grave! This is the night of which it is written: And the night shall be as bright as the day; and the night is my light in my delight.

The sanctification of this night therefore drives away wickedness, washes away guilt, restores innocence to the fallen and gladness to the sorrowful. It banishes hatred, prepares concord and bows down earthly pride.

In the grace of this night, then, receive, O holy Father, the evening sacrifice of this incense, which Holy Church offers to Thee in the solemn offering of this candle, the work of bees, through the hands of her ministers. We know now the praise of this pillar which the shining fire kindles in honour of God. Though its light is divided among many flames, it suffers no loss by being shared, for it is fed by the melting wax which the mother bee produced for the substance of this precious lamp.

O truly blessed night, which despoiled the Egyptians and enriched the Hebrews! A night in which heavenly things are joined to earthly, and divine things to human.

We beseech Thee, therefore, O Lord, that this candle, consecrated to the honour of Thy Name, may continue unfailing to dispel the darkness of this night. Accepted as a sweet fragrance, may it mingle with the lights of heaven. May the morning star find its flame still burning: that Star, we mean, which knows no setting, Christ, Who returning from the grave shone serenely upon mankind.

We beseech Thee, therefore, O Lord, that Thou wouldst deign, in the joy of this Paschal feast, to rule, govern and preserve with Thy continual protection us Thy servants, all the clergy and Thy devout people, together with our most holy Pope N. and our Bishop N., granting us peaceful times. Look also upon those who exercise authority over us, and by the ineffable gift of Thy goodness and mercy direct their thoughts toward justice and peace, that from their earthly labour they may come with all Thy people to the heavenly homeland.

Through the same Jesus Christ, Thy Son, our Lord, Who with Thee lives and reigns in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, for ever and ever.
℟. Amen.
exsultet.fr: Que désormais la troupe des anges tressaille de joie dans le ciel ; que les divins mystères exultent, et que pour la victoire d’un si grand Roi retentisse la trompette du salut.

prophecies.lat: Quattuor lectiones seu Prophetiae leguntur, cum canticis et orationibus propriis: Genesis 1:1–2:2; Exodus 14:24–15:1; Isaias 4:2–6; Deuteronomium 31:22–30.
prophecies.en: Four Lessons or Prophecies are read, each with its appointed canticle and prayer: Genesis 1:1–2:2; Exodus 14:24–15:1; Isaiah 4:2–6; Deuteronomy 31:22–30.
prophecies.fr: Quatre leçons ou Prophéties sont lues, avec leurs cantiques et oraisons propres.

fontOverview.lat: Litaniae Sanctorum incipiuntur. Prima pars Litaniarum ad fontem baptismalem ducit; ibi fons benedicitur. Aqua lustralis deinde sumitur ad aspersionem fidelium; altera pars Litaniarum continuatur dum altare ad Missam praeparatur. Haec pagina ordinem huius actionis indicat; textus integri benedictionis fontis non hic reproducuntur.
fontOverview.en: The Litany of the Saints begins. Its first part leads to the baptismal font, where the font is blessed. Lustral water is then taken for the aspersion of the faithful; the second part of the Litany continues while the altar is prepared for Mass. This screen gives the sequence of the ceremony; the full celebrant-only blessing of the font is not reproduced here.
fontOverview.fr: La Litanie des Saints commence. Sa première partie conduit à la bénédiction des fonts baptismaux. Après la bénédiction des fonts, on prélève l’eau lustrale pour l’aspersion des fidèles ; la Litanie reprend ensuite pendant la préparation de l’autel pour la Messe.

lauds.lat:
Ant. Allelúia, allelúia, allelúia.

Psalmus 150
Laudáte Dóminum in sanctis eius: laudáte eum in firmaménto virtútis eius.
Laudáte eum in virtútibus eius: laudáte eum secúndum multitúdinem magnitúdinis eius.
Laudáte eum in sono tubæ: laudáte eum in psaltério et cíthara.
Laudáte eum in týmpano et choro: laudáte eum in chordis et órgano.
Laudáte eum in cýmbalis benesonántibus: laudáte eum in cýmbalis iubilatiónis: omnis spíritus laudet Dóminum.
℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
Ant. Allelúia, allelúia, allelúia.

Marc 16:2
Ant. Et valde mane una sabbatórum, véniunt ad monuméntum, orto iam sole, allelúia.

BENEDICTUS
Luc 1:68-79
Benedíctus ✠ Dóminus Deus Israël: quia visitávit et fecit redemptiónem plebis suæ.
Et eréxit cornu salútis nobis: in domo David púeri sui.
Sicut locútus est per os sanctórum, qui a sǽculo sunt, prophetárum eius:
Salútem ex inimícis nostris: et de manu ómnium, qui odérunt nos.
Ad faciéndam misericórdiam cum pátribus nostris: et memorári testaménti sui sancti.
Iusiurándum, quod iurávit ad Ábraham patrem nostrum: datúrum se nobis.
Ut sine timóre, de manu inimicórum nostrórum liberáti, serviámus illi.
In sanctitáte et iustítia coram ipso: ómnibus diébus nostris.
Et tu, puer, Prophéta Altíssimi vocáberis: præíbis enim ante fáciem Dómini paráre vias eius.
Ad dandam sciéntiam salútis plebi eius: in remissiónem peccatórum eórum.
Per víscera misericórdiæ Dei nostri: in quibus visitávit nos, óriens ex alto.
Illumináre his, qui in ténebris et in umbra mortis sedent: ad dirigéndos pedes nostros in viam pacis.
℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
Ant. Et valde mane una sabbatórum, véniunt ad monuméntum, orto iam sole, allelúia.
lauds.en:
Ant. Alleluia, alleluia, alleluia.

Psalm 150
Praise the Lord in His holy places: praise Him in the firmament of His power.
Praise Him for His mighty deeds: praise Him according to the multitude of His greatness.
Praise Him with the sound of the trumpet: praise Him with psaltery and harp.
Praise Him with timbrel and choir: praise Him with strings and organ.
Praise Him with well-sounding cymbals: praise Him with cymbals of jubilation: let every spirit praise the Lord.
℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost.
℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.
Ant. Alleluia, alleluia, alleluia.

Mark 16:2
Ant. And very early on the first day of the week, they come to the tomb, the sun having now risen, alleluia.

BENEDICTUS
Luke 1:68-79
Blessed ✠ be the Lord God of Israel: because He hath visited and wrought the redemption of His people.
And hath raised up a horn of salvation to us: in the house of David His servant.
As He spoke by the mouth of His holy prophets, who are from the beginning:
Salvation from our enemies and from the hand of all that hate us.
To perform mercy to our fathers: and to remember His holy covenant.
The oath which He swore to Abraham our father, that He would grant to us:
That being delivered from the hand of our enemies, we may serve Him without fear,
In holiness and justice before Him, all our days.
And thou, child, shalt be called the prophet of the Most High: for thou shalt go before the face of the Lord to prepare His ways.
To give knowledge of salvation to His people: unto the remission of their sins.
Through the bowels of the mercy of our God: in which the Orient from on high hath visited us.
To enlighten them that sit in darkness and in the shadow of death: to direct our feet into the way of peace.
℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost.
℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.
Ant. And very early on the first day of the week, they come to the tomb, the sun having now risen, alleluia.
lauds.fr: Après la Communion, il n’y a pas d’antienne de Communion. À sa place, les Laudes sont chantées ; au Benedictus, on encense l’autel, les ministres, les servants et les fidèles.

renewal.lat:
Hac sacratíssima nocte, fratres caríssimi, sancta Mater Ecclésia, recólens Dómini nostri Iesu Christi mortem et sepultúram, eum redamándo vígilat; et, celébrans eiúsdem gloriósam resurrectiónem, lætabúnda gaudet.
Quóniam vero, ut docet Apóstolus, consepúlti sumus cum Christo per baptísmum in mortem, quómodo Christus resurréxit a mórtuis, ita et nos in novitáte vitæ opórtet ambuláre; sciéntes, véterem hóminem nostrum simul cum Christo crucifíxum esse, ut ultra non serviámus peccáto. Existimémus ergo nos mórtuos quidem esse peccáto, vivéntes autem Deo in Christo Iesu Dómino nostro.
Quaprópter, fratres caríssimi, quadragesimáli exercitatióne absolúta, sancti baptísmatis promissiónes renovémus, quibus olim Sátanæ et opéribus eius, sicut et mundo, qui inimícus est Dei, abrenuntiávimus, et Deo in sancta Ecclésia cathólica fidéliter servíre promísimus. Itaque:
renewal.en:
On this most holy night, beloved brethren, Holy Mother Church recalls the death and burial of Our Lord Jesus Christ, keeps vigil in return for His love, and rejoices in celebrating His glorious Resurrection.
As the Apostle teaches, we were buried with Christ through baptism into death; just as Christ rose from the dead, so we must walk in newness of life. Our old self was crucified with Christ, so that we should no longer serve sin. Let us reckon ourselves dead to sin, but alive to God in Christ Jesus our Lord.
Therefore, dearly beloved, as the Lenten observance is completed, let us renew the promises of holy Baptism, by which we renounced Satan, his works and the world, the enemy of God, and promised faithfully to serve God in His holy Catholic Church. Therefore:
renewal.fr:
En cette nuit très sainte, frères bien-aimés, notre Mère la sainte Église se souvient de la mort et de la sépulture de Notre-Seigneur Jésus-Christ ; elle veille par amour pour lui et se réjouit de célébrer sa glorieuse Résurrection.
Comme l'enseigne l'Apôtre, nous avons été ensevelis avec le Christ par le baptême dans sa mort ; de même que le Christ est ressuscité des morts, nous devons marcher dans une vie nouvelle. Notre vieil homme a été crucifié avec le Christ afin que nous ne soyons plus esclaves du péché. Considérons-nous donc comme morts au péché, mais vivants pour Dieu dans le Christ Jésus notre Seigneur.
C'est pourquoi, frères bien-aimés, le temps du Carême achevé, renouvelons les promesses de notre saint baptême : nous avons renoncé à Satan, à ses œuvres et au monde, ennemi de Dieu, et promis de servir fidèlement Dieu dans la sainte Église catholique. Ainsi :

℣. And all his pomps?

professions.lat:
℣. Créditis in Deum, Patrem omnipoténtem, Creatórem cæli et terræ?
℟. Crédimus.
℣. Créditis in Iesum Christum, Fílium eius únicum, Dóminum nostrum, natum et passum?
℟. Crédimus.
℣. Créditis et in Spíritum Sanctum, sanctam Ecclésiam cathólicam, sanctórum communiónem, remissiónem peccatórum, carnis resurrectiónem et vitam ætérnam?
℟. Crédimus.
professions.en:
℣. Do you believe in God, the Father almighty, Creator of heaven and earth?
℟. We do believe.
℣. Do you believe in Jesus Christ, His only Son, our Lord, born and suffered?
℟. We do believe.
℣. Do you believe also in the Holy Ghost, the holy Catholic Church, the communion of Saints, forgiveness of sins, resurrection of the body and life everlasting?
℟. We do believe.
professions.fr:
℣. Croyez-vous en Dieu, le Père tout-puissant, Créateur du ciel et de la terre ?
℟. Nous croyons.
℣. Croyez-vous en Jésus-Christ, son Fils unique, notre Seigneur, qui est né et a souffert ?
℟. Nous croyons.
℣. Croyez-vous aussi au Saint-Esprit, à la sainte Église catholique, à la communion des Saints, à la rémission des péchés, à la résurrection de la chair et à la vie éternelle ?
℟. Nous croyons.

pater.lat:
℣. Nunc autem una simul Deum precémur, sicut Dóminus noster Iesus Christus oráre nos dócuit:
℟. Pater noster, qui es in cælis, sanctificétur nomen tuum. Advéniat regnum tuum. Fiat volúntas tua, sicut in cælo et in terra. Panem nostrum quotidiánum da nobis hódie, et dimítte nobis débita nostra, sicut et nos dimíttimus debitóribus nostris. Et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem, sed líbera nos a malo.
℣. Et Deus omnípotens, Pater Dómini nostri Iesu Christi, qui nos regenerávit ex aqua et Spíritu Sancto, quique nobis dedit remissiónem peccatórum, ipse nos custódiat grátia sua in eódem Christo Iesu Dómino nostro in vitam ætérnam.
℟. Amen.
pater.en:
℣. And now let us pray together as our Lord Jesus Christ taught us to pray:
℟. Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be Thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread, and forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us. And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil.
℣. May almighty God, the Father of Our Lord Jesus Christ, who regenerated us by water and the Holy Ghost and granted us forgiveness of sins, keep us by His grace in Christ Jesus Our Lord unto everlasting life.
℟. Amen.
pater.fr:
℣. Prions maintenant tous ensemble Dieu, comme Notre-Seigneur Jésus-Christ nous a appris à prier :
℟. Notre Père, qui êtes aux cieux, que votre nom soit sanctifié ; que votre règne arrive ; que votre volonté soit faite sur la terre comme au ciel. Donnez-nous aujourd'hui notre pain quotidien ; pardonnez-nous nos offenses, comme nous pardonnons à ceux qui nous ont offensés ; et ne nous laissez pas succomber à la tentation, mais délivrez-nous du mal.
℣. Que Dieu tout-puissant, Père de Notre-Seigneur Jésus-Christ, qui nous a régénérés par l'eau et le Saint-Esprit et nous a accordé la rémission des péchés, nous garde par sa grâce dans le Christ Jésus notre Seigneur pour la vie éternelle.
℟. Amen.

aspersion.fr: Les fidèles sont aspergés après le renouvellement des promesses baptismales.

segments.latin:
℣. Dóminus vobíscum.
℟. Et cum spíritu tuo.
Orémus.
segments.english:
℣. The Lord be with you.
℟. And with thy spirit.
Let us pray.
segments.french:
℣. Le Seigneur soit avec vous.
℟. Et avec votre esprit.
Prions.

segments.latin:
Omnípotens sempitérne Deus, adésto magnæ pietátis tuæ mystériis, adésto sacraméntis: et ad recreándos novos pópulos, quos tibi fons baptismátis párturit, spíritum adoptiónis emítte; ut, quod nostræ humilitátis geréndum est ministério, virtútis tuæ impleátur efféctu. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
℟. Amen.
segments.english:
Almighty and everlasting God, be present at the mysteries of thy great kindness and at the sacraments. Send forth the spirit of adoption to renew the people born to thee from this baptismal font, so that what is accomplished by our lowly ministry may be fulfilled through thy power. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, for ever and ever.
℟. Amen.
segments.french:
Dieu tout-puissant et éternel, assiste aux mystères de ta grande bonté et à tes sacrements. Envoie l'esprit d'adoption pour renouveler le peuple que cette fontaine baptismale fait naître pour toi ; que ta puissance accomplisse ce qui est confié à notre humble ministère. Par Notre-Seigneur Jésus-Christ, ton Fils, qui vit et règne avec toi dans l'unité du Saint-Esprit, Dieu, pour les siècles des siècles.
℟. Amen.

℣. The Lord be with you.

℟. Cela est juste et bon.

segments.latin: Vere dignum et iustum est, æquum et salutáre, nos tibi semper et ubíque grátias ágere, Dómine, sancte Pater, omnípotens ætérne Deus: qui invisíbili poténtia, sacramentórum tuórum mirabíliter operáris efféctum: et licet nos tantis mystériis exsequéndis simus indígni: tu tamen grátiæ tuæ dona non déserens, étiam ad nostras preces aures tuæ pietátis inclínas. Deus, cuius Spíritus super aquas inter ipsa mundi primórdia ferebátur: ut iam tunc virtútem sanctificatiónis aquárum natúra concíperet.
segments.english: It is truly fitting and just, right and salutary, always and everywhere to give thee thanks, holy Lord, almighty Father, everlasting God. By thy unseen power thou wondrously workest through thy sacraments; although we are unworthy to perform such mysteries, thou hearest our prayers in thy mercy without withdrawing the gifts of thy grace. O God, whose Spirit moved above the waters at the world's beginning, so that water might even then receive the power of sanctification.
segments.french: Il est vraiment digne et juste, équitable et salutaire de te rendre grâces toujours et partout, Seigneur, Père saint, Dieu tout-puissant et éternel. Par ta puissance invisible, tu accomplis admirablement les effets de tes sacrements ; malgré notre indignité, tu prêtes dans ta bonté l'oreille à nos prières. Ô Dieu, dont l'Esprit planait sur les eaux aux origines du monde, afin que l'eau reçût déjà la vertu de sanctification.

segments.latin: Deus, qui nocéntis mundi crímina per aquas ábluens, regeneratiónis spéciem in ipsa dilúvii effusióne signásti: ut uníus eiúsdemque eleménti mystério, et finis esset vítiis, et orígo virtútibus. Réspice, Dómine, in fáciem Ecclésiæ tuæ, et multíplica in ea regeneratiónes tuas, qui grátiæ tuæ affluéntis ímpetu lætíficas civitátem tuam: fontémque baptísmatis áperis toto orbe terrárum géntibus innovándis: ut tuæ maiestátis império, sumat Unigéniti tui grátiam de Spíritu Sancto.
segments.english: O God, by the waters of the flood thou didst wash away the crimes of a guilty world and foreshadow regeneration, so that the same element should end vice and give rise to virtue. Look upon thy Church, and multiply within her those born again. Thou makest thy city glad with abundant grace and openest the baptismal font throughout the earth, that the nations may be renewed by the grace of thine only-begotten Son through the Holy Ghost.
segments.french: Ô Dieu, qui as lavé par les eaux du déluge les fautes du monde coupable et figuré ainsi la régénération, pour que cet élément fût à la fois la fin des vices et l'origine des vertus. Regarde ton Église et multiplie en elle les renaissances ; par l'abondance de ta grâce tu réjouis ta cité et ouvres partout la fontaine du baptême pour renouveler les nations par la grâce de ton Fils unique dans le Saint-Esprit.

segments.latin: Qui hanc aquam, regenerándis homínibus præparátam, arcána sui núminis admixtióne fecúndet: ut sanctificatióne concépta, ab immaculáto divíni fontis útero, in novam renáta creatúram, progénies cæléstis emérgat: et quos aut sexus in córpore, aut ætas discérnit in témpore, omnes in unam páriat grátia mater infántiam. Prócul ergo hinc, iubénte te, Dómine, omnis spíritus immúndus abscédat: prócul tota nequítia diabólicæ fraudis absístat.
segments.english: May he make fruitful this water prepared for the regeneration of men, by the hidden working of his divinity, so that a heavenly offspring may come forth from the spotless womb of this sacred font, reborn to a new creation; and all who differ in age or sex may receive one infancy through grace. At thy command, O Lord, let every unclean spirit depart and every deceit of the devil be driven far away.
segments.french: Qu'il féconde cette eau préparée pour la régénération des hommes par l'action secrète de sa divinité, afin que surgisse du sein immaculé de cette fontaine sainte une descendance céleste, renouvelée par la grâce ; que tous, quel que soit leur âge ou leur sexe, reçoivent une seule enfance spirituelle. À ton ordre, Seigneur, que s'éloignent les esprits impurs et toutes les ruses du démon.

segments.latin: Nihil hoc loci hábeat contráriæ virtútis admíxtio: non insidiándo circúmvolet: non laténdo súbrepat: non inficiéndo corrúmpat.
segments.english: Let no hostile power mingle here, or circle about in ambush, or creep in secretly, or corrupt this water with its poison.
segments.french: Qu'aucune puissance ennemie ne s'y mêle, ne rôde pour dresser des embûches, ne s'y glisse en secret et ne la corrompe de son venin.

segments.latin: Sit hæc sancta et ínnocens creatúra, líbera ab omni impugnatóris incúrsu, et totíus nequítiæ purgáta discéssu. Sit fons vivus, aqua regénerans, unda puríficans: ut omnes hoc lavácro salutífero diluéndi, operánte in eis Spíritu Sancto, perféctæ purgatiónis indulgéntiam consequántur.
segments.english: May this holy and innocent creature be free from every assault of the enemy and cleansed of all malice. May it be a living fountain, regenerating water and purifying stream, so that all washed in this saving bath may obtain perfect cleansing through the work of the Holy Ghost.
segments.french: Que cette créature sainte et innocente soit délivrée des attaques de l'ennemi et purifiée de toute malice. Qu'elle soit fontaine de vie, eau de renaissance et flot purificateur, afin que tous ceux qui seront lavés dans ce bain salutaire obtiennent la parfaite purification par l'action du Saint-Esprit.

segments.latin: Unde benedíco te, creatúra aquæ, per Deum ✠ vivum, per Deum ✠ verum, per Deum ✠ sanctum: per Deum, qui te in princípio verbo separávit ab árida: cuius Spíritus super te ferebátur.
segments.english: Therefore I bless thee, creature of water, by the living ✠ God, the true ✠ God, the holy ✠ God, who in the beginning separated thee from dry land by his word and whose Spirit hovered above thee.
segments.french: C'est pourquoi je te bénis, créature de l'eau, par le Dieu ✠ vivant, le Dieu ✠ véritable, le Dieu ✠ saint, qui au commencement te sépara de la terre ferme par sa parole et dont l'Esprit planait sur toi.

segments.latin: Qui te paradísi fonte manáre fecit, et in quátuor flumínibus totam terram rigáre præcépit. Qui te in desérto amáram, suavitáte índita, fecit esse potábilem, et sitiénti pópulo de petra prodúxit. Bene ✠ díco te et per Iesum Christum Fílium eius únicum, Dóminum nostrum: qui te in Cana Galilǽæ signo admirábili sua poténtia convértit in vinum. Qui pédibus super te ambulávit, et a Ioánne in Iordáne in te baptizátus est.
segments.english: He caused thee to spring from paradise and water the whole earth by four rivers. In the desert he made bitter water sweet and brought thee forth from the rock for his thirsty people. I bless ✠ thee also through Jesus Christ, his only Son, our Lord, who changed thee into wine at Cana, walked upon thee and was baptized in thee by John in the Jordan.
segments.french: Il t'a fait jaillir de la source du paradis et arroser la terre entière par quatre fleuves. Au désert, il adoucit tes eaux amères et te fit sortir du rocher pour désaltérer son peuple. Je te bénis ✠ aussi par Jésus-Christ, son Fils unique, Notre-Seigneur, qui te changea en vin à Cana, marcha sur toi et reçut en toi le baptême de Jean au Jourdain.

segments.latin: Qui te una cum sánguine de látere suo prodúxit: et discípulis suis iussit, ut credéntes baptizaréntur in te, dicens: Ite, docéte omnes gentes, baptizántes eos in nómine Patris, et Fílii, et Spíritus Sancti.
segments.english: He made thee flow forth with blood from his side and commanded his disciples that believers should be baptized in thee, saying: Go, teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Ghost.
segments.french: Il t'a fait jaillir de son côté avec son sang et a commandé à ses disciples de baptiser les croyants en toi : Allez, enseignez toutes les nations et baptisez-les au nom du Père, du Fils et du Saint-Esprit.

segments.latin: Hæc nobis præcépta servántibus tu, Deus omnípotens, clemens adésto: tu benígnus aspíra. Tu has símplices aquas tuo ore benedícito: ut præter naturálem emundatiónem, quam lavándis possunt adhibére corpóribus, sint étiam purificándis méntibus efficáces.
segments.english: Almighty God, graciously assist us as we keep these commands. Bless these pure waters by thy word, so that beyond their natural power to wash bodies they may also purify souls.
segments.french: Dieu tout-puissant, assiste avec clémence ceux qui observent tes commandements. Bénis de ta bouche ces eaux simples, afin qu'outre la purification naturelle des corps, elles aient aussi la puissance de purifier les âmes.

segments.latin: Descéndat in hanc plenitúdinem fontis virtus Spíritus Sancti. Totámque huius aquæ substántiam regenerándi fecúndet efféctu.
segments.english: May the power of the Holy Ghost descend into all the fullness of this font and make the whole substance of this water fruitful for regeneration.
segments.french: Que la puissance du Saint-Esprit descende dans toute cette fontaine et féconde toute la substance de cette eau pour produire la régénération.

segments.latin:
Hic ómnium peccatórum máculæ deleántur: hic natúra ad imáginem tuam cóndita, et ad honórem sui reformáta princípii, cunctis vetustátis squalóribus emundétur: ut omnis homo, sacraméntum hoc regeneratiónis ingréssus, in veræ innocéntiæ novam infántiam renascátur. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum: qui ventúrus est iudicáre vivos et mórtuos, et sǽculum per ignem.
℟. Amen.
segments.english:
Here may every stain of sin be removed. Here may nature, made in thy image and restored to the dignity of its origin, be cleansed of the defilements of the old life, so that everyone receiving this sacrament of regeneration may be reborn into a new infancy of true innocence. Through our Lord Jesus Christ thy Son, who shall come to judge the living and the dead and the world by fire.
℟. Amen.
segments.french:
Qu'ici soient effacées les taches de tous les péchés ; qu'ici la nature créée à ton image et rétablie dans l'honneur de son origine soit purifiée des souillures anciennes, afin que quiconque reçoit ce sacrement de régénération renaisse à la nouvelle enfance de la véritable innocence. Par Notre-Seigneur Jésus-Christ, ton Fils, qui viendra juger les vivants et les morts et le monde par le feu.
℟. Amen.

segments.latin:
Sanctificétur ✠ et fecundétur fons iste Oleo salútis renascéntibus ex eo, in vitam ætérnam.
℟. Amen.
segments.english:
May this font be sanctified ✠ and made fruitful by the oil of salvation for those who are reborn from it unto everlasting life.
℟. Amen.
segments.french:
Que cette fontaine soit sanctifiée ✠ et fécondée par l'huile du salut pour ceux qui y renaîtront à la vie éternelle.
℟. Amen.

segments.latin:
Infúsio Chrísmatis Dómini nostri Iesu Christi, et Spíritus Sancti Parácliti, fiat in nómine sanctæ Trinitátis.
℟. Amen.
segments.english:
May the pouring of the Chrism of our Lord Jesus Christ and of the Holy Ghost the Paraclete take place in the name of the Holy Trinity.
℟. Amen.
segments.french:
Que l'infusion du saint Chrême de Notre-Seigneur Jésus-Christ et du Saint-Esprit Paraclet se fasse au nom de la Sainte Trinité.
℟. Amen.

segments.latin:
Commíxtio Chrísmatis sanctificatiónis, et Olei unctiónis, et aquæ baptísmatis, páriter fiat in nómine Pa ✠ tris, et Fí ✠ lii, et Spíritus ✠ Sancti.
℟. Amen.
segments.english:
May the mingling of the Chrism of sanctification, the oil of anointing and the water of baptism be accomplished in the name of the ✠ Father and of the ✠ Son and of the Holy ✠ Ghost.
℟. Amen.
segments.french:
Que le mélange du Chrême de sanctification, de l'huile d'onction et de l'eau baptismale se fasse au nom du ✠ Père, du ✠ Fils et du ✠ Saint-Esprit.
℟. Amen.

separateBaptistery.note: When the font is in a separate baptistery, the cantor repeats the first Litany as needed while the ministers proceed. The 1962 witness assigns the canticle Sicut cervus to the procession.

chant.latin: Sicut cervus desíderat ad fontes aquárum: ita desíderat ánima mea ad te, Deus.
chant.english: As the hart longs for springs of water, so my soul longs for thee, O God.
chant.french: Comme le cerf soupire après les sources d'eau, ainsi mon âme soupire après toi, ô Dieu.

chant.latin: Sitívit ánima mea ad Deum vivum: quando véniam, et apparébo ante fáciem Dei?
chant.english: My soul thirsts for the living God; when shall I come and appear before his face?
chant.french: Mon âme a soif du Dieu vivant : quand viendrai-je paraître devant la face de Dieu ?

chant.latin: Fuérunt mihi lácrimæ meæ panes die ac nocte: dum dícitur mihi per síngulos dies: Ubi est Deus tuus?
chant.english: My tears have been my bread day and night, while they say continually: Where is thy God?
chant.french: Mes larmes sont devenues mon pain jour et nuit, lorsqu'on me demande sans cesse : Où est ton Dieu ?

atFont.latin: Omnípotens sempitérne Deus, réspice propítius ad devotiónem pópuli renascéntis, qui sicut cervus aquárum tuárum éxpetit fontem: et concéde propítius; ut fídei ipsíus sitis, baptísmatis mystério, ánimam corpúsque sanctíficet. Per Christum Dóminum nostrum.
atFont.english: Almighty and everlasting God, look graciously upon this people approaching rebirth, who thirst after the font of thy waters like the hart; grant that their thirst for faith may sanctify soul and body through the sacrament of baptism. Through Christ our Lord.
atFont.french: Dieu tout-puissant et éternel, regarde avec bonté le peuple qui va renaître, qui désire la source de tes eaux comme le cerf altéré ; que sa soif de foi sanctifie son âme et son corps par le sacrement du baptême. Par le Christ Notre-Seigneur.

conditionalBaptism.authority: Rituale Romanum, Titulus II (ordo depends on infants/adults, candidate number and minister); liturgical text is not identical to a short one-formula insert
conditionalBaptism.note: The Missale Romanum explicitly refers the actual baptisms to the Rituale Romanum; this app surface is only the location and reader handoff, not the text of that sacrament.

editorial.noFontBranch: Font prayer and procession must be entirely absent when FONT_MODE=NONE
editorial.separateFontBranch: Font blessing is performed at the baptistery, not repeated on returning.
editorial.waterForAspersion: Water for aspersion after renewal is drawn off before the Holy Oils are added.
editorial.noClaim: No formal 1962 printed-typica text-image or approved vernacular translation certification
